posts.title: Review: Onyx Boox Go 7 Color Gen II
posts.description: This year, I decided to get a new ereader. Longtime readers may remember that I previously used an Onyx Boox Nova 3, acquired in 2020. There is absolutely nothing wrong with that device. It still works wonderfully. I just wanted something smaller and more portable.

posts.title: Isle au Haut Camping Trip
posts.description: To celebrate Labor Day, we traveled nearly as far East as you can go in the USA, all the way to the coast of Maine: Isle au Haut in Acadia National Park.

posts.title: Late Summer VT Bikepacking: Part 4 (Montpelier to Littleton)
posts.description: Our final day of the bike trip took us across two states, and ended with mild disappointment. In retrospect, we'll call the Late Summer VT Bikepacking a success, but the Later Summer NH Rail Trail Riding an abject failure.
